smoke = load_tutorial_spec("01", "smoke")
atoms = initialize_atoms(smoke)
control = summarize_initialization(
    atoms, smoke, provenance(Path("configs/post-01/smoke.json")).config_sha256
)
print(f"atoms={control.atom_count}, density={control.number_density:.4f} A^-3")
print(
    f"ASE draw: target={control.target_temperature_k:.1f} K, "
    f"observed={control.instantaneous_temperature_k:.2f} K"
)
print(f"center-of-mass speed={control.center_of_mass_speed:.3e}")
